text: Ko menen woni yiɗɓe mon ɓen ka nguurndam aduna, tawde men semmbinayno on men reena on, ko menen kadi woni yiɗɓe mon ɓen ka laakara: ngol giggol no heddii. Hino woodani on ka Aljanna, kala ko wonkiiji mon faaletee, immorde e dakammeeji e muuyanteeji. Hino woodani on ton kadi, kala ko faaleteɗon.
